user.title: Connect a VARRAM account
user.description: Sign in with the account email and password. The integration validates the newly issued app token before saving the account.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew VARRAM authentication
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the account email and password to sign in, or provide a replacement app token.

reconfigure.title: Update VARRAM credentials
reconfigure.description: Provide the account email and password to test and save automatic sign-in, or paste a replacement app token.

error.invalid_auth: The app token or account credentials were rejected, or belong to another account.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to VARRAM. Try again when the service is reachable.
error.credentials_required: Enter an app token or both account fields.
error.credentials_pair_required: Enter both the account email and password, or leave both blank.

abort.already_configured: This VARRAM account is already configured.

invalid_auth.message: The VARRAM app token expired or was rejected. Reauthenticate or update the saved account credentials.

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to the VARRAM service.

feeding_busy.message: Another feeder request is already running. Try again after it finishes.

feeding_cooldown.message: A feed request was sent recently. Check the feeder before pressing again.

feeding_calibration_missing.message: VARRAM did not report a valid calibration minimum. The request was not sent.

feeding_calibration_unavailable.message: Could not verify the feeder calibration. The request was not sent.

feeding_status_unavailable.message: Could not verify fresh feeder status and remaining food. The request was not sent.

feeding_state_blocked.message: The feeder is not in a safe state for additional feeding. The request was not sent.

feeding_overfull.message: The latest feeder status reports more than 60 g remaining. The request was not sent.

feeding_auth.message: VARRAM authentication could not be verified. The request was not sent.

feeding_not_ready.message: The VARRAM feeder is not ready. The request was not sent.

feeding_outcome_unknown.message: The request may have been sent, but its outcome is unknown. Check the feeder before pressing again.

feeding_execution_unknown.message: VARRAM acknowledged the request, but feeder execution was not confirmed. Check the feeder before pressing again.

feeding_failed.message: The feeder reported a bowl or feed failure after starting. Check the feeder before trying again.
